Primary 30-day AAD results from Table 3 selected. The XML table column order is Outcome measures, Total number with values, LcS group, Placebo group; the quoted row contains both arm-specific counts and denominators in that order. Arm names occur in the separate table header, not within the short numeric row spans. These are participant counts, not episode counts. Participants were adults with spinal cord injury requiring antibiotics. Randomised totals were 181 LcS and 178 placebo; Table 3 reports 257 participants with 30-day values and 102 missing. Secondary seven-day AAD results are LcS 53 /163 (32.5%) and placebo 48 /152 (31.6%). PPI subgroup results are reported separately as 19% versus 35.7% at seven days and 28% versus 52.2% at 30 days. The abstract describes the primary window as up to 30 days after finishing LcS/placebo, whereas Methods defines it relative to completion of antibiotics; the Methods/Table 3 antibiotic-based window is used here. The research-in-context box prints 44.6% versus 42.1%, unlike Table 3 and the primary-results narrative, which print 45% versus 42.1%.

Counts are participants with AAD, not episodes. Efficacy analysis used the 555 completers (282 probiotic mix; 273 placebo), described as a modified intention-to-treat population. Randomized totals were 285 and 279, respectively; 3 and 6 discontinued early without efficacy data and were excluded. These randomized totals also apply to the safety analysis. Overall AAD incidence is selected; antibiotic-class subgroups and mild/moderate AAD are separately reported secondary or subgroup results. AAD was defined as at least 3 loose or liquid stools over 24 hours.

Table 2 columns are Probiotic Mix, Placebo, Total; the placebo event span preserves the XML row and its column order. Table 2 states all values are n (%), so placebo percentage_text is the printed 0.0 without an added percent sign. All participants with AEs experienced only 1 AE. The serious event was total hysterectomy requiring hospitalization. Safety denominators are 285 and 279; efficacy denominators of 282 and 273 exclude early discontinuations and are not used here.

The abstract reports deaths without restricting cause. The denominators are stated as patients who received each intervention; the abstract does not explicitly label them as randomized, analyzed, or safety-set totals. The stated window describes treatment duration; a separate mortality assessment window is NOT_IN_PACKET. The primary composite endpoint percentages (29.7% and 32.7%) concern cardiovascular death or hospitalization for HF, not all-cause mortality.

Events are patients with serious adverse events: 28 in the tocilizumab group and 12 in the placebo group. The report separately states 36 and 38 serious adverse event episodes, respectively. Denominators are from Table 4, Adverse Events in the Safety Population. The modified intention-to-treat population instead has 161 tocilizumab patients and 81 placebo patients; one patient intubated before receiving placebo was excluded from that population but included in the safety population. Percentages for patients with any serious adverse event are NOT_IN_PACKET. A 28-day follow-up period is described for efficacy outcomes, but an explicit serious-adverse-event assessment window is NOT_IN_PACKET.
